source.title: Agent QA + V16.1 integration: Brown & Walton B2B website expansion
source.body:
## Goal
Review PR #3 against Brown & Walton's **approved V16.1 multi-page site**, then implement compliant supplier and buyer intake on top of that approved release. **Do not replace V16.1 with the older single-page GitHub main branch.**

## Audit before coding
- Locate the real V16.1 production source and compare files, Netlify deploy settings, routes and assets.
- Explain why the user's last Netlify manual upload showed only a landing page; reproduce by reloading direct routes and checking build publish directory. Avoid silent redirects that disguise missing files.
- Check existing typography, white headline readability, small black body text, mobile layout, logo and animated backgrounds.

## Implement
- Two dedicated B2B flows (manufacturer / buyer) based on PR #3 prototype and docs/b2b-expansion-phase-1.md.
- A live, secure form backend or Netlify Forms with clear status/error, email notification, anti-spam and a private lead queue.
- Lead states: new, qualify, contacted, replied, follow-up, converted / not suitable. Separate buyer and supplier records, and permissioned access.
- Do NOT build an unlicensed alcohol sales cart, order-taking or commission checkout system.
- Keep existing contact, international sourcing, Street Stillers, and non-B2B pages working.

## Prove it works
- Run npm tests/build and show results.
- Manual desktop + iOS Safari flow tests at 320, 375, 768, 1280 px; direct link and refresh on every real page.
- Test actual staging form submission end-to-end: Netlify capture, notification email, duplicate prevention and error state.
- Show real before/after screenshots, contrast measurements, keyboard navigation and reduced-motion behavior.
- Verify no private contact lists or uploaded spreadsheets are published or exposed in client source.
- Document any AGCO/legal assumptions needing confirmation.
- Obtain approval before merging or deploying to live site.

Related draft pull request: #3. The prototype is a demonstration and **never sends data**.
